name: tinyvg2svg
description: A TinyVG to SVG converter - transform TinyVG vector graphics into standard SVG format

scripts.build:web: mkdir -p dist-web/wasm && esbuild src/web.ts --bundle --minify --outfile=dist-web/app.js --format=esm --target=es2020 && cp web/index.html dist-web/ && cp web/wasm/svg2tvg.js web/wasm/svg2tvg_bg.wasm dist-web/wasm/
scripts.build:wasm: cd crates/svg2tvg-wasm && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/svg2tvg_wasm.wasm --target web --no-typescript --out-dir ../../web/wasm --out-name svg2tvg
